name: Conditional Antimatroids Are Projection-Closed
statement: Every nonempty coordinate projection of a finite conditional-antimatroid graph class is again a conditional-antimatroid graph class.
proof: Projection preserves ampleness and cannot increase Horn-renaming defect, because it retains exactly the minimal missing patterns supported on the surviving coordinates. Thus a projection of an ample class with $H=0$ is again ample with $H=0$.
